description: Phoeve Beta: run the fixed deployment entry point. The caller chooses an action and, only for a deployment, a digest-pinned image pair. It cannot choose what the host executes.

action.description: Deployment action. No other value is accepted.

apiImage.description: API image reference, digest-pinned. Required when action is deploy.

webImage.description: SPA image reference, digest-pinned. Required when action is deploy.

runCommand: if ! [[ "$api_image" =~ $digest_pinned ]]; then echo 'apiImage must be a digest-pinned image reference' >&2; exit 64; fi
if ! [[ "$web_image" =~ $digest_pinned ]]; then echo 'webImage must be a digest-pinned image reference' >&2; exit 64; fi
